title: Eight picks. Three useful checks.
spoken: Eight sources picked eight different robot vacuums. We compared the reviews behind those headlines. Here are three findings that change which winners deserve a place on your shortlist.

title: First cut: embedded pet hair
spoken: First, pet hair in carpet? RTINGS finds that both the Saros ten R and the original Qrevo Curv struggle with it. Two headline winners, one shared weakness. For that job, we would set both aside and start with RTINGS’ dedicated pet-hair comparison.

title: Next: two winners in the same test

title: Same test, different strengths
spoken: The Curv two Flow led its mopping results. But it failed the flat side of a thirty-millimetre doorstep. The X sixty cleared fifty millimetres both ways. Our read: keep the Flow for a mopping-first home; favor the X sixty in this pair if tall thresholds are the dealbreaker.

title: One last check before choosing
spoken: But before choosing the Flow, check the floor clutter. Its obstacle score in that same test was two out of six. So that mopping recommendation comes with a condition: you may need to clear the floor first. Watch the obstacle test before buying.
